claim_scope: The randomised-graph control for I32rank64fixed10k. Identical recipe, corpus, budget and seed; the only difference is that the connectome's specific wiring is destroyed while its degree structure and weight multiset are preserved exactly. Tests whether the fly's anatomy contributes anything beyond its connectivity statistics.
test_policy: deferred until comparison and final protocol are fixed
initialization_note: Same from-scratch trainer initialization and seed42; preserve encoder and neuron initialization. Rank64 changes readout shapes and initial logit variance relative to rank128; verify rank64-specific gradients and optimizer updates before training.
prerequisites: Confirm no competing GPU worker on macm3
Training corpus is a strict superset of the 1,000-story set; validation, test and audit rows are byte-identical

graph_control.method: global permutation of the presynaptic index array, followed by targeted source swaps that remove the self-loops and duplicate edges the permutation creates; a swap exchanges the source values of two edge slots, so it leaves every row offset and the out-degree multiset untouched
destroys: which particular neuron connects to which
graph_control.note: The sparse backend rejects duplicate edges rather than silently coalescing them, so the repair is a correctness requirement, not a cosmetic one. 118,705 of 9,050,172 edges (1.31%) survive by chance at their original endpoints.
